-- | Type builtins type (+), type GHC.Monad, type GHC.MonadTrans, KnownNat
--   Identity, ReacT, StateT, Vec, Finite, Ref (..), Proxy (..) Maybe,
--   Either, Bool Products?
--   
--   Primitives Defined Types/Data structs: Monad, MonadTrans, Ref a=Ref

-- | Note: this is not injective (e.g., VecConcat has two notations)
--   
--   Note: there are Builtins that don't have direct corresponding
--   notations (e.g. Bits is used in lit, but not directly)
builtinUserQName :: [(Builtin, Text)]
builtinUserName :: [(Builtin, Text)]

-- | Cases where we need to include specific handling for rewire-user
--   definitions:
--   
--   <ol>
--   <li>We need to print punctuation and infix notations carefully</li>
--   <li>We may need to differentiate based on type information in some
--   circumstances: a. We can't define a single operator over different
--   monads (or can we?) b. We need to differentiate between vector and
--   word operations</li>
--   <li>We include Builtins because we handle them at the same
--   junctures</li>
--   </ol>
--   
--   We can handle other cases by writing a function or synonym in the
--   Isabelle ReWire session (rewire-embedder/targets/isabelle/thys)
data RWUserOp
RWBuiltin :: Builtin -> RWUserOp
CompDot :: RWUserOp
CompDol :: RWUserOp
BindI :: RWUserOp
BindS :: RWUserOp
BindR :: RWUserOp
BindRInf :: RWUserOp
Seq :: RWUserOp
SeqI :: RWUserOp
SeqS :: RWUserOp
SeqR :: RWUserOp
SeqRInf :: RWUserOp
RBindI :: RWUserOp
RBindS :: RWUserOp
RBindR :: RWUserOp
RBindRInf :: RWUserOp
ReturnI :: RWUserOp
ReturnS :: RWUserOp
ReturnR :: RWUserOp
LiftS :: RWUserOp
LiftR :: RWUserOp
WordIndexProxy :: RWUserOp
WordIndexFin :: RWUserOp

BOr :: RWUserOp
BXOr :: RWUserOp
FinAdd :: RWUserOp
FinSub :: RWUserOp
FinMul :: RWUserOp
FinDiv :: RWUserOp

WordIndex :: RWUserOp

module Embedder.Atmo.Types
class TypeAnnotated a
typeOf :: TypeAnnotated a => a -> Maybe Ty
tyAnn :: TypeAnnotated a => a -> Maybe Poly
setTyAnn :: TypeAnnotated a => Maybe Poly -> a -> a
tupleTy :: Annote -> [Ty] -> Ty
arr :: Ty -> Ty -> Ty
infixr 1 `arr`
intTy :: Annote -> Ty
strTy :: Annote -> Ty
nilTy :: Ty
refTy :: Annote -> Ty -> Ty
(|->) :: [Text] -> Ty -> Poly
infix 1 |->
rangeTy :: Ty -> Ty
sig :: [Ty] -> Ty -> Ty
flattenSig :: Ty -> ([Ty], Ty)
pairTy :: Annote -> Ty -> Ty -> Ty

-- | Given 'a -&gt; (b -&gt; c)' returns 'b -&gt; c'.
arrowRight :: Ty -> Ty

-- | Given 'a -&gt; (b -&gt; c)' returns <tt>a</tt>.
arrowLeft :: Ty -> Ty
higherOrder :: Ty -> Bool

-- | Types with no built-ins (Strings, Integers, lists).
fundamental :: Ty -> Bool

-- | Types containing no type variables (or blanks).
concrete :: Ty -> Bool
paramTys :: Ty -> [Ty]
finMax :: Ty -> Maybe Natural
proxyNat :: Ty -> Maybe Natural
finiteTy :: Annote -> Natural -> Ty
vecSize :: Ty -> Maybe Natural
vecElemTy :: Ty -> Maybe Ty
vecTy :: Annote -> Ty -> Ty -> Ty
evalNat :: Ty -> Maybe Natural

-- | Takes [T1, ..., Tn-1] Tn and returns (T1 -&gt; (T2 -&gt; ... (T(n-1)
--   -&gt; Tn) ...))
mkArrowTy :: [Ty] -> Ty -> Ty
mkTyApp :: Annote -> Ty -> [Ty] -> Ty
poly :: [Text] -> Ty -> Poly
poly' :: Ty -> Poly
listTy :: Annote -> Ty -> Ty
plusTy :: Annote -> Natural -> Natural -> Ty
dstPlusTy :: Ty -> Maybe (Ty, Ty)
isReacT :: Ty -> Bool
isStateT :: Ty -> Bool
ctorNames :: Ty -> [Text]
resInputTy :: Ty -> Maybe Ty
dstArrow :: Ty -> Maybe (Ty, Ty)

-- | This takes a type of the form
--   
--   <pre>
--   StateT S1 (StateT S2 (... (StateT Sm I)))
--   </pre>
--   
--   and returns
--   
--   <pre>
--   [S1, ..., Sm]
--   </pre>
dstStateT :: Ty -> Maybe [Ty]

-- | This takes a type of the form
--   
--   <pre>
--   m a
--   </pre>
--   
--   and returns
--   
--   <pre>
--   Just (m, a)
--   </pre>
dstTyApp :: Ty -> Maybe (Ty, Ty)

-- | This takes a type of the form
--   
--   <pre>
--   ReacT In Out (StateT S1 (StateT S2 (... (StateT Sm I)))) T
--   </pre>
--   
--   and returns
--   
--   <pre>
--   (In, Out, [S1, ..., Sm], T)
--   </pre>
dstReacT :: Ty -> Maybe (Ty, Ty, [Ty], Ty)
proxyTy :: Annote -> Natural -> Ty
dstNegTy :: Ty -> Maybe Ty
negTy :: Annote -> Ty -> Ty
dstPoly1 :: Ty -> Maybe Poly1

zeroP1 :: Poly1
pickVar :: Poly1 -> Maybe (Text, Poly1)

module Embedder.Atmo.FlattenMonadTrans

-- | transMonadT Convert `StateT s (StateT t (StateT u Identity)) a` to
--   `State (s,(t,(u,()))) a` Convert `ReacT i o m a` to `Re i o s a` where
--   s = mkState an (getStates m)

-- | A thin shim over rewire-base's <a>ReWire.Config</a> adding the
--   embedder's output-file helpers. The embedder ignores the
--   hardware-oriented config fields (clock, reset, signal names, etc.).
module Embedder.Config

-- | Output path for the generated Isabelle theory (.thy) file.
getEmbedFile :: Config -> FilePath -> FilePath

-- | Output path for the generated Atmo IR (.atmo) file.

module Embedder.Atmo.ToIsabelle

-- | The rewire-user library modules, by theory name. Their Isabelle
--   semantics is the hand-written session (targets/isabelle/thys, imported
--   as <tt>ReWire.Atmo</tt>), so embedding them would emit theories
--   nothing imports. Matched against the theory name rather than the
--   output path, which <tt>-o</tt> overrides.
rewireUserMods :: [Text]
embedModule :: MonadError AstError m => FilePath -> Module -> m (Maybe Theory)
embedFreeProgram :: MonadError AstError m => FilePath -> FreeProgram -> m Theory
tFreeProgram :: MonadError AstError m => FreeProgram -> m ([Decl], Graph, [Tree Vertex])
tModule :: MonadError AstError m => Module -> m ([Decl], Graph, [Tree Vertex])
tDeclaration :: MonadError AstError m => Declaration -> m Decl
tTypeSynonym :: Monad m => TypeSynonym -> m Decl
tDefn :: MonadError AstError m => Defn -> m Decl
tFunBinding :: MonadError AstError m => FunBinding -> m ([Pttrn], Term)
tFun :: MonadError AstError m => Defn -> m (Text, TypSig, [([Pttrn], Term)])
tRDefns :: MonadError AstError m => [Defn] -> m Decl
tDataDefn :: Monad m => DataDefn -> m Decl
tRecDefn :: Monad m => RecDefn -> m Decl
tDataCon :: Monad m => DataCon -> m DatatypeConstructor
tType :: Ty -> Typ
tTypeSig :: Ty -> TypSig
tPoly :: Monad m => Poly -> m ([TName], Typ)
tPolySig :: Monad m => Poly -> m ([TName], TypSig)

-- | translates (t1,t2,t3,t4) to (t1,(t2,(t3,t4))))
flattenTyTuple :: Ty -> Ty
flattenTy :: Ty -> (Ty, [Ty])
tExp :: Monad m => Exp -> m Term
tPat :: Pat -> Pttrn
tPatBind :: Monad m => PatBind -> m (Pttrn, Term)

-- | Case Annote !(Maybe Poly) !(Maybe Ty) !Exp ![PatBind]
flattenCase :: Exp -> (Exp, [(Pat, Exp)])
tCase :: Monad m => (Pat, Exp) -> m (Pttrn, Term)
tGlobal :: Text -> Text
tLocal :: Text -> Text
getBaseName :: Text -> Text
filterName :: Text -> Text
isReWire :: Show a => a -> Bool

-- | The boundary between haskell-src-exts source locations and ReWire's
--   native <a>Annote</a>/<a>Span</a>. It lives in the HSE layer so the
--   base annotation module (ReWire.Annotation) and the diagnostics
--   renderer (ReWire.Error) carry no haskell-src-exts dependency: only
--   modules that actually manipulate the haskell-src-exts AST import this
--   conversion glue.
module ReWire.HSE.SrcLoc
instance ReWire.Annotation.Annotation Language.Haskell.Exts.SrcLoc.SrcLoc
instance ReWire.Annotation.Annotation Language.Haskell.Exts.SrcLoc.SrcSpanInfo
instance Language.Haskell.Exts.SrcLoc.SrcInfo ReWire.Annotation.Annote

module ReWire.HSE.Parse
tryParseInDir :: (MonadIO m, MonadError AstError m) => FilePath -> FilePath -> m (Maybe (FilePath, Module SrcSpanInfo))

module ReWire.HSE.Fixity

-- | Renames local operators and fixes local and file-scope fixities.
--   applyFixities appears to be intended to handle this automatically, but
--   it seems to be buggy and not allow inner fixity declarations to shadow
--   outer ones (on operators with the same name). Note: applyFixities
--   annoyingly fixes the annotation type as SrcSpanInfo.
fixLocalOps :: (MonadState AstError m, MonadFail m) => Module SrcSpanInfo -> m (Module SrcSpanInfo)
deuniquifyLocalOps :: Module SrcSpanInfo -> Module SrcSpanInfo
getFixities :: [Decl a] -> [Fixity]

module ReWire.HSE.Rename
data Renamer
fixFixity :: (MonadFail m, MonadState AstError m) => Renamer -> Module SrcSpanInfo -> m (Module SrcSpanInfo)
getExports :: ModuleName () -> Renamer -> Exports
allExports :: Renamer -> Exports
exclude :: QNamish a => Namespace -> [a] -> Renamer -> Renamer
extend :: QNamish a => Namespace -> [(a, FQName)] -> Renamer -> Renamer

-- | True iff an entry for the name exists in the renamer.
finger :: QNamish a => Namespace -> Renamer -> a -> Bool
rename :: (QNamish a, QNamish b) => Namespace -> Renamer -> a -> b
data FQName
qnamish :: (QNamish a, QNamish b) => a -> b

-- | Sometimes-partial conversion between name-like things.
class QNamish a
data Namespace
Type :: Namespace
Value :: Namespace
data Exports
expValue :: FQName -> Exports -> Exports
expType :: FQName -> Set FQName -> FQCtorSigs -> Exports -> Exports
expFixity :: Assoc () -> Int -> Name () -> Exports -> Exports
expCtorSigs :: Exports -> FQCtorSigs

-- | Things in the export list of the named thing (ctors or fields).
getCtors :: QNamish a => a -> Exports -> Set FQName

-- | Map from type name to its set of data constructors. Note: the set of
--   "ctors" also includes fields (things that might appear in an export
--   list).
type Ctors = Map Name () Set Name ()

-- | Qualified (globally-unique) version of the above map.
type FQCtors = Map FQName Set FQName

-- | Map from constructor name to its field "signature," which is a list of
--   field names and types.
type CtorSigs = Map Name () [(Maybe Name (), Type ())]

-- | Qualified (globally-unique) version of the above map.
type FQCtorSigs = Map FQName [(Maybe FQName, Type ())]
setCtors :: Ctors -> CtorSigs -> Renamer -> Renamer
getLocalTypes :: Renamer -> Set (Name ())
getLocalCtorSigs :: Renamer -> CtorSigs
lookupCtors :: QNamish a => Renamer -> a -> Set FQName
lookupCtorSig :: QNamish a => Renamer -> a -> [(Maybe FQName, Type ())]
lookupCtorSigsForType :: QNamish a => Renamer -> a -> FQCtorSigs
findCtorSigFromField :: QNamish a => Renamer -> a -> Maybe (FQName, [(Maybe FQName, Type ())])
toFilePath :: ModuleName a -> FilePath

-- | Build renamer from a single import line. Should work on either pre- or
--   post-desugared import lists. Params: module being imported,
--   "qualified", exports (of this import), "... as &lt;qualifier&gt;",
--   imports.
fromImps :: (Functor m, MonadError AstError m) => ModuleName () -> Bool -> Exports -> Maybe (ModuleName ()) -> Maybe (ImportSpecList SrcSpanInfo) -> m Renamer
instance GHC.Classes.Eq ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance GHC.Classes.Eq ReWire.HSE.Rename.Namespace
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic ReWire.HSE.Rename.Exports
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic ReWire.HSE.Rename.Namespace
instance GHC.Internal.Generics.Generic ReWire.HSE.Rename.Renamer
instance Data.Hashable.Class.Hashable ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance Data.Hashable.Class.Hashable ReWire.HSE.Rename.Namespace
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monoid ReWire.HSE.Rename.Exports
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monoid ReWire.HSE.Rename.Renamer
instance GHC.Classes.Ord ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance GHC.Classes.Ord ReWire.HSE.Rename.Namespace
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish (Language.Haskell.Exts.Syntax.Name ())
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish (Language.Haskell.Exts.Syntax.Name Language.Haskell.Exts.SrcLoc.SrcSpanInfo)
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish (Language.Haskell.Exts.Syntax.Name ReWire.Annotation.Annote)
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish (Language.Haskell.Exts.Syntax.QName ())
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish (Language.Haskell.Exts.Syntax.QName ReWire.Annotation.Annote)
instance ReWire.HSE.Rename.QNamish Data.Text.Internal.Text
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Semigroup ReWire.HSE.Rename.Exports
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Semigroup ReWire.HSE.Rename.Renamer

instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show ReWire.HSE.Rename.Namespace
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show ReWire.HSE.Rename.Renamer
instance TextShow.Classes.TextShow ReWire.HSE.Rename.Exports
instance TextShow.Classes.TextShow ReWire.HSE.Rename.FQName
instance TextShow.Classes.TextShow ReWire.HSE.Rename.Namespace
instance TextShow.Classes.TextShow ReWire.HSE.Rename.Renamer


-- | Verbose pass tracing for the HSE front end (the haskell-src-exts
--   halves of what ReWire.Pass used to provide; the HSE-free scaffolding
--   stays in rewire-frontend).
module ReWire.HSE.PassInfo

-- | Dump the header plus (when verbose) the renamer, exports, imports, and
--   the Show'd module. The imports and module are taken pre-rendered so
--   callers can choose the rendering.
printInfoTop :: MonadIO m => Text -> Renamer -> Text -> Bool -> Text -> m ()
printInfoHSE :: MonadIO m => Text -> Renamer -> Text -> Bool -> Module a -> m (Module a)

module ReWire.HSE.Desugar

-- | Desugar into lambdas then normalize the lambdas.
desugar :: MonadError AstError m => Renamer -> Module Annote -> m (Module Annote)

-- | Adds the "module Main where" if no module given (but not the "main"
--   export).
addMainModuleHead :: Module a -> Module a
data Desugar (m :: Type -> Type)
Desugar :: Tr m (Module Annote) -> Tr m (Pat Annote) -> Tr m (ConDecl Annote) -> Tr m (Exp Annote) -> Tr m (Type Annote) -> Tr m (DeclHead Annote) -> Tr m (Binds Annote) -> Tr m (Match Annote) -> Tr m (Alt Annote) -> Tr m (QName Annote) -> Tr m (Decl Annote) -> Desugar (m :: Type -> Type)
[dsModule] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Module Annote)
[dsPat] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Pat Annote)
[dsConDecl] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (ConDecl Annote)
[dsExp] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Exp Annote)
[dsType] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Type Annote)
[dsDeclHead] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (DeclHead Annote)
[dsBinds] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Binds Annote)
[dsMatch] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Match Annote)
[dsAlt] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Alt Annote)
[dsQName] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (QName Annote)
[dsDecl] :: Desugar (m :: Type -> Type) -> Tr m (Decl Annote)
pass :: Monad m => Desugar m -> Module Annote -> m (Module Annote)
type Fresh = Int
fresh :: (MonadState Fresh m, Monad m) => Annote -> m (Name Annote)
err :: Annote -> String -> Exp Annote
mkTuple :: Annote -> Int -> Name Annote

-- | Desugar record type defs, field accessors, record patterns, record
--   construction expressions, and record update syntax.
--   
--   <pre>
--   R {f = a}
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   R _ a _
--   </pre>
--   
--   and
--   
--   <pre>
--   r { f = a }
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case r of R x0 _ x1 -&gt; R x0 a x1
--   </pre>
desugarRecords :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadState Fresh m, MonadError AstError m) => Renamer -> Desugar m

-- | Turns Specials into normal identifiers.
normIds :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Removes parens in types, expressions, and patterns so they don't
--   confuddle everything.
deparenify :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Turns sections and infix ops into regular applications and lambdas.
desugarInfix :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). MonadState Fresh m => Desugar m

-- | TODO Apparently this should actually desugar to guards:
--   
--   <pre>
--   f (-k) = v
--   </pre>
--   
--   is actually sugar for
--   
--   <pre>
--   f z | z == negate (fromInteger k) = v
--   </pre>
desugarNegLitPats :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Turns tuples into applications of a tuple constructor (also in types
--   and pats):
--   
--   <pre>
--   (x, y, z)
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   ((,,) x y z)
--   </pre>
desugarTuples :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Turns piece-wise function definitions into a single PatBind with a
--   lambda and case expression on the RHS. E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   f p1 p2 = rhs1
--   f q1 q2 = rhs2
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   f = \ $1 $2 -&gt; case ($1, $2) of { (p1, p2) -&gt; rhs1; (q1, q2) -&gt; rhs2 }
--   </pre>
desugarFuns :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadState Fresh m, MonadError AstError m) => Desugar m

-- | Turns
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e of {...}
--   </pre>
--   
--   into
--   
--   <pre>
--   (\ x -&gt; case x of {...}) e
--   </pre>
liftDiscriminator :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). MonadState Fresh m => Desugar m

-- | Turn cases with multiple alts into cases with two alts: an alt with a
--   pattern and another with a default, wildcard branch.
--   
--   <pre>
--   case x of
--     p1 -&gt; e1
--     p2 -&gt; e2
--     p3 -&gt; e3
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case x of
--     p1 -&gt; e1
--     _  -&gt; case x of
--             p2 -&gt; e2
--              _ -&gt; case x of
--                     p3 -&gt; e3
--                      _ -&gt; undefined
--   </pre>
flattenAlts :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Should run after function desugarage. From the Haskell 98 report:
--   
--   <pre>
--   case v of
--     p | g1 -&gt; e1
--       | gn -&gt; en where { decls }
--     _    -&gt; e'
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e' of
--     y -&gt; case v of
--       p -&gt; let { decls } in
--         if g1 then e1 else if gn then en else y
--       _ -&gt; y
--   </pre>
desugarGuards :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). MonadState Fresh m => Desugar m

-- | Turns where clauses into lets. Only valid after guard desugarage.
--   E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   f x = a where a = b
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   f x = let a = b in a
--   </pre>
wheresToLets :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). MonadError AstError m => Desugar m

-- | Turns do-notation into a series of &gt;&gt;= \ x -&gt;. Turns LetStmts
--   into Lets. E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   do p1 &lt;- m
--      let p2 = e
--      return e
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   m &gt;&gt;= (\ p1 -&gt; (let p2 = e in return e))
--   </pre>
desugarDos :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadState Fresh m, MonadError AstError m) => Desugar m
normTyContext :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Turns the type a -&gt; b into (-&gt;) a b.
desugarTyFuns :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Turns Lets into Cases. Assumes functions in Lets are already
--   desugared. E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   let p = e1
--       q = e2
--   in e3
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e1 of { p -&gt; (case e2 of { q -&gt; e3 } }
--   </pre>
desugarLets :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadState Fresh m, MonadError AstError m) => Desugar m

-- | Turns ifs into cases.
--   
--   <pre>
--   if e1 then e2 else e3
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e1 of { True -&gt; e2; False -&gt; e3 }
--   </pre>
desugarIfs :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m
desugarNegs :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Turns Lambdas with several bindings into several lambdas with single
--   bindings. E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   \ p1 p2 -&gt; e
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   \ p1 -&gt; \ p2 -&gt; e
--   </pre>
flattenLambdas :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m

-- | Replaces non-var patterns in lambdas with a fresh var and a case.
--   E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   \ (a, b) -&gt; e
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   \ $x -&gt; case $x of { (a, b) -&gt; e }
--   </pre>
depatLambdas :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). MonadState Fresh m => Desugar m

-- | Desugars as-patterns in (and only in) cases into more cases. Should
--   run after depatLambdas. E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e1 of
--     x@(C y@p) -&gt; e2
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e1 of { C p -&gt; (\ x -&gt; ((\ y -&gt; e2) p)) (C p) }
--   </pre>
desugarAsPats :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadState Fresh m, MonadError AstError m) => Desugar m

-- | Turns beta-redexes into cases. E.g.:
--   
--   <pre>
--   (\ x -&gt; e2) e1
--   </pre>
--   
--   becomes
--   
--   <pre>
--   case e1 of { x -&gt; e2 }
--   </pre>
lambdasToCases :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). Monad m => Desugar m
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monad m => GHC.Internal.Base.Monoid (ReWire.HSE.Desugar.Desugar m)
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monad m => GHC.Internal.Base.Semigroup (ReWire.HSE.Desugar.Desugar m)

module Embedder.HSE.Desugar

-- | Desugar into lambdas then normalize the lambdas. This differs from
--   ReWire.HSE.Desugar's pipeline: tuples, records, case flattening, and
--   discriminator lifting are deferred to the Atmo IR, and unguarded
--   multi-clause function bindings are kept intact (see
--   <a>desugarFuns</a>).
desugar :: MonadError AstError m => Renamer -> Module Annote -> m (Module Annote)

-- | Adds the "module Main where" if no module given (but not the "main"
--   export).
addMainModuleHead :: Module a -> Module a


-- | Export-list resolution on the HSE AST, used by the embedder
--   (Embedder.HSE.ToAtmo).
module ReWire.HSE.Exports

-- | An intermediate form for exports. TODO(chathhorn): get rid of it.
data Export
Export :: FQName -> Export

-- | ExportWith: Type name, ctors
ExportWith :: FQName -> Set FQName -> FQCtorSigs -> Export
ExportAll :: FQName -> Export
ExportMod :: ModuleName () -> Export
ExportFixity :: Assoc () -> Int -> Name () -> Export
sDeclHead :: DeclHead a -> (Name (), [TyVarBind ()])
exportAll :: QNamish a => Renamer -> a -> Export
getExportFixities :: [Decl Annote] -> [Export]
transExport :: MonadError AstError m => Renamer -> [Decl Annote] -> [Export] -> ExportSpec Annote -> m [Export]
tysynNames :: [Decl Annote] -> [Name ()]
getTypeExports :: Renamer -> [Decl Annote] -> [Export]
resolveExports :: Renamer -> [Export] -> Exports

-- | Collect INLINE/NOINLINE pragmas into a map from the pragma'd name to
--   an attribute built from the pragma's polarity (True for INLINE).
getInlines :: (Bool -> a) -> [Decl Annote] -> Map (Name ()) a
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show ReWire.HSE.Exports.Export


-- | The two module-loader helpers the HSE front end's recursive import
--   loader (ReWire.HSE.Cache) needs: computing a module's global-name
--   renamer extension and its effective import list.
module ReWire.HSE.Globs
extendWithGlobs :: Annotation a => Module a -> Renamer -> Renamer
getImps :: Annotation a => Module a -> [ImportDecl a]


-- | The IR-agnostic part of the HSE front end: locating, parsing, and
--   caching modules and (recursively) their imports. The per-module
--   pipeline (desugaring and translation out of the HSE AST) is supplied
--   by the caller; the embedder instantiates it for Atmo (see
--   <a>Embedder.ModCache</a>).
module ReWire.HSE.Cache
type Cache mod (m :: Type -> Type) = StateT HashMap FilePath (mod, Exports) m
type LoadPath = [FilePath]
runCache :: Monad m => Cache mod m a -> m a

-- | Locates a module in the load path, parses it, loads its imports
--   (recursively, with caching), and runs the supplied translation, which
--   takes the module's file path, renamer, loaded imports, and HSE AST to
--   the target IR. The translation's result is cached per file path.
getModuleWith :: forall mod (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadIO m, MonadError AstError m, Monoid mod) => (FilePath -> Renamer -> mod -> Module SrcSpanInfo -> Cache mod m (mod, Exports)) -> Config -> FilePath -> FilePath -> Cache mod m (mod, Exports)

module Embedder.HSE.ToAtmo

-- | Translate a Haskell module into the Atmo abstract syntax. Name
--   Handling: Fresh m, rename returns an FQName which is then T.packaged
--   into an Export
toAtmo :: MonadError AstError m => Renamer -> Module Annote -> m (Module, Exports)

module ReWire.HSE.Annotate

-- | Replace every haskell-src-exts source span in a parsed module with the
--   compiler's own annotation, recording each node's origin span.
annotate :: Module SrcSpanInfo -> Module Annote

-- | The annotation carried by every IR node: its provenance plus any
--   human-readable context breadcrumbs accumulated as it travels through
--   the passes.
data Annote

module Embedder.ModCache
runCache :: (MonadIO m, MonadError AstError m) => Cache m a -> m a
type LoadPath = [FilePath]
getModule :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). (MonadIO m, MonadFail m, MonadError AstError m, MonadState AstError m) => Config -> FilePath -> FilePath -> Cache m (Module, Exports)

module Embedder.FrontEnd
embedFile :: MonadIO m => Config -> FilePath -> m ()
type LoadPath = [FilePath]
